if.foreach: ( SELECT #{model.id} AS model_config_id, 'LATEST' AS health_bucket, log.success, log.status, log.created_at, log.error_message FROM ai_call_log log WHERE log.deleted = 0 AND (log.model_name = #{model.modelCode} OR log.model = #{model.modelCode}) AND ( log.route_trace = #{model.provider} OR log.route_trace LIKE CONCAT(#{model.provider}, ' -> %') OR log.route_trace LIKE CONCAT('% -> ', #{model.provider}) ) ORDER BY log.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT #{model.id} AS model_config_id, 'SUCCESS' AS health_bucket, log.success, log.status, log.created_at, log.error_message FROM ai_call_log log WHERE log.deleted = 0 AND (log.model_name = #{model.modelCode} OR log.model = #{model.modelCode}) AND ( log.route_trace = #{model.provider} OR log.route_trace LIKE CONCAT(#{model.provider}, ' -> %') OR log.route_trace LIKE CONCAT('% -> ', #{model.provider}) ) AND COALESCE(log.success, log.status) = 1 ORDER BY log.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT #{model.id} AS model_config_id, 'FAILURE' AS health_bucket, log.success, log.status, log.created_at, log.error_message FROM ai_call_log log WHERE log.deleted = 0 AND (log.model_name = #{model.modelCode} OR log.model = #{model.modelCode}) AND ( log.route_trace = #{model.provider} OR log.route_trace LIKE CONCAT(#{model.provider}, ' -> %') OR log.route_trace LIKE CONCAT('% -> ', #{model.provider}) ) AND COALESCE(log.success, log.status) = 0 ORDER BY log.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 )
